orchestration.recovery_user_instruction: After a software reboot, wait for the router-wide LED reboot blink/restart cue, then immediately hold Reset through 2-short+3-long red flashes and steady red. If missed: power OFF, power ON, wait about 1 second, hold Reset 5-10 seconds until the same red sequence. Reset held before power-on is Airoha BootROM.
orchestration.bootrom_emergency_ursusboot: EXPERT BootROM uses exact alpha3 preloader + alpha3 RAM installer + alpha3 emergency FIP/BL2. Emergency lineage is separate from alpha5-UBIUX1 production target.

orchestration.gate_policy: Automatic preflight -> exact summary -> one ordinary y/N immediately before direct mtd0 persistent write. No codeword or duplicate confirmation. EXPERT item 1 may explicitly skip the full stock backup for that run; normal ONE-CLICK still requires it.
orchestration.one_key_payload_validation: lazy by detected state/transition; no startup all-payload/all-firmware gate
orchestration.upload_retry_policy: Interrupted FIP/FIT upload remains RAM-only/NOT_STARTED before operation POST; wait through reconnect grace, then require an operator y/N before starting a new complete transfer session.

ursusboot.ubi_commit: alpha5-UBIUX1 WebFailsafe UBI update validates the complete image in RAM, then selects staged fit.new/fit.old update when headroom permits or a direct Recovery-safe FIT replacement when MAX-16 rootfs_data leaves insufficient staging PEBs. notes.test59: 0.2.59 public test: restores visible keep/reset settings policy control after prior completed/failed operations; fixes Web reboot after ordinary UBI update; enforces ASCII/English machine UART logs; permits direct Recovery-safe replacement when a smaller FIT improves or preserves existing UBI headroom.
notes.test60: 0.2.60 public test: CONFIGTRIM1 disables unused U-Boot UBIFS filesystem commands and extlinux/PXE parser/command path; UBI/TFTP/WGET and ursusdispatch are retained.
notes.test61: 0.2.61 TEST61 SAFETYREG1 fixes the TEST58-60 split identity class, removes automatic installed-UrsusBoot self-update from ONE-CLICK, reuses the already-correct UBI attachment without detach, makes interrupted uploads operator-restartable while preserving NOT_STARTED before the operation endpoint, keeps the UI reusable after non-writing failures, and restores one y/N before direct mtd0 write. TEST59/60 are revoked for hardware use.

ui.policy: STATEUI8 DIAGAUTH1/BACKUPRAW1 over STATEUI7 MENUOPS1; menu remains task-oriented, explicit diagnostics may authenticate read-only, and item 7 has a self-contained raw BootROM backup path.

baseline.policy: STATEUI8 DIAGAUTH1/BACKUPRAW1: passive state is informational; explicit diagnostics may ask for root SSH; OpenWrt UBI backup is exact 256 MiB raw NAND capture through RAM. Firmware payloads are unchanged.
baseline.emergency_confirmation: legacy destructive backend retained; no extra confirmation ceremony added by 0.2.55
